name: AutoTrust JEV-27B-VL

based_on.note: Fine-tuned from Qwen3.8-27B (card base_model). Not made by TypeSafe, despite the name.

summary: AutoTrust's 27B vision decision model; ranked first of 20 on the community Decision Index 0.3 vision board (69.82). Needs one 80 GB+ GPU. Decision model: it answers typed questions (yes/no, choice, score) with probabilities through a Jev-compatible /v1/systemone endpoint. It does not chat or write text.

practical_baseline.reason: Decision models are not ranked by the chat-model baseline policy; pick by hardware and API.
